errors.evidence: The label on the x-axis is '部件处所' (Component Place), not '事件处所' (Event Place).
The values for the '空间实体' category are 31.6%, 31.3%, and 31.6%. They are not all 31.6%.
The values for '事件' are 22.1% (training set), 21.8% (validation set), and 21.7% (test set). The description incorrectly states the training set value as 22.6% and the test set value as 21.5%.
The value for the validation set ('验证集') in the '处所' category is 19.1%, not 19.5%.
The value for the validation set ('验证集') in the '方向' category is 8.8%, not 8.7%.
The values for '原文时间' are approximately 4.9%, 4.7%, and 4.2%. The description incorrectly states the last value (test set) as 4.7%.
The values for '终点' are 4.6%, 4.4%, and 5.1%. The description incorrectly states the middle value (validation set) as 4.6%.
The values for '起点' are 2.6%, 1.8%, and 2.7%. The description incorrectly reports the first two values as 2.7% and 2.6%.
The values for '事实性' are 1.2%, 1.0%, and 1.7%. The description incorrectly states the second and third values as 1.2% and 1.5%.
The values for '路径' are 1.0%, 1.5%, and 1.1%. The description incorrectly states the first two values as 1.1% and 0.9%.
The values for '部位' are 1.0%, 1.4%, and 0.9%. The description incorrectly states the middle value (validation set) as 1.0%.
The values for '隐式距离' are 0.1%, 0.1%, and 0.2%. Stating that all three parts are close to 0.1% is inaccurate, as the test set value is double the others.
